description: One recommendation for what your user needs, and the next step to start using it, as the site's Operator (/operator) picks it. Pass the need in a sentence you write yourself, e.g. "query Postgres and send email": each need it names gets one pick, why it fits, the next step (the MCP client config to paste when the vendor's docs give one, else its setup guide or docs) and two alternatives; two or more picks also come with a /stack link. Name a product to prefer the listings that mention it; say MCP, CLI, API, browser extension or official to narrow the pick. Picked by fixed matching rules, not a model, so the same need always gets the same answer. A need that matches no task is refused with the closest tasks. Never include names, email addresses or phone numbers.

official.description: Official: a first-party listing, published by the company behind the product under its own domain or GitHub org (e.g. Notion's own Notion MCP, not a community build), where that company is a major vendor (publicly traded, a frontier AI lab, or valued around $1B+). It records who publishes the product, not a paid placement, and is separate from Verified.

verified.description: Verified: we checked it works — its URLs load and its declared access (API, MCP, CLI or extension) responds. Re-checked monthly; the label drops if it stops working.
